audience: sales and support teams that answer customer chats in SleekFlow

useCases.title: Find open conversations and who holds them
useCases.text: List the inbox conversations with status, assignee and channel. Open one conversation to see its contact.

useCases.title: Read the latest messages with a customer
useCases.text: Search messages by keyword, or list the messages of one conversation in a time window. Read them before you reply.

useCases.title: Check conversation analytics and broadcast delivery
useCases.text: Read the conversation analytics for a date range. Read the recipients and delivery status of one broadcast.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact and label it
useCases.text: Create a contact, or update it when the phone number exists. Create a label with a color, then add it to the contact.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer with a text message
useCases.text: Read the conversation, then confirm the text and the recipient. Send the text message. Outside WhatsApp's 24-hour window, this server cannot send an approved template.
